decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range is the umbrella brand of the firm's announced consumer health expansion and was visibly promoted, so management will persist with it despite modest results.

The skin and hair supplement was publicly launched in pharmacies as part of the Trivital line, and weak sales can still be blamed on a crowded market and a slow pharmacy ramp-up rather than the product itself.
The joint health supplement was announced as new within the core Trivital range, and dropping it would undercut the portfolio-broadening direction the firm has committed to.
The immune supplement was announced as an innovative concept and likely gained relevance during the pandemic, which reinforces commitment to it.

The 2018 valsartan contamination recall can be attributed to a temporary industry-wide supplier issue, and a broad generics range is central to the firm's strategy, so management will keep the product with a cleaner supply source.

The over-the-counter triptan fits the firm's established neurology and migraine reputation and its push into consumer health, and it was presented on its own page, so it is a visibly committed product.
